method: Direct retrieval with the page-fetch tool; controlling text read against the consolidated register. This is retrieval and semantic-review evidence, not a continuous live monitor.

sources.notes: All residential owners report; tenant-occupied reporting generates license; current license required before increase goes into effect; March 1 deadline; late filing has no monetary penalty; submissions public and under penalty of perjury.
Read full subsections (a)-(e). Small-building/condo reporting commenced March 1, 2023; suspension is prospective-restoration only.
Read annual 60%-of-CPI/7% ceiling, banking, additional occupants, petition provisions, notice content and null-and-void text. No entity-size distinction in ordinary annual cap.
Full PDF read. Current 1.6% for 2026-03-01 through 2027-02-28; no 2027-28 value. Two-digit years 82-99 are 1982-1999, not 2082-2099.

Current rate, base-rent-only, no rounding up, 12-month timing, 30/90-day notice, five extra mailing days, roommate surcharge prohibition and worked examples read. First example mislabels a June 2025 rate as 1.6%; Form 571 says 1.4% for that period. Multi-year example also contains an availability-date parenthetical inconsistency; do not treat examples as property rulings.

Page states 24 full months without any increase; Rule 4.12 states 12 months from availability. Reconciliation is analysis, not a quoted unified rule. Example contains a 2024/2025 rate-label inconsistency; arithmetic uses 1.4% for August 2025.

Read Rules 4.10 and 4.12 in retrieved chunks. 4.12 requires 12 months from availability, no compounding/rounding up, banked portion and dates disclosed; omission of banked detail alone does not void under 4.12(b).
Periodic residential tenancies: personal or CCP 1013 mail service; 30 days at <=10%, 90 days >10%, cumulative prior-12-month test. Subsidized recertification exception exists; subsidy status unknown.
State cap 5%+CPI or 10%; local stricter rent-control exclusion in (d)(3); owner-occupied two-unit exemption conditions read.
SF AB1482 maximum 8.8% for 2026-08-01 through 2027-07-31; explicitly does not apply to units under SF Rent Ordinance increase limits.
June 13, 1979 cutoff is a coverage indicator, not proof for an unidentified parcel. Exemptions and free counselor hours read.
2026-27 fee $59/unit, March 1 deadline, 5% monthly penalty capped at 15%; fee exemption does not satisfy Inventory reporting. No claim that fee delinquency alone suspends the license.
Add percentages, do not compound; no petition; base rent only; no rounding up. Worked 8.2% example re-derived successfully.
6.14 notice generally within 60 days of knowledge; last original occupant must vacate. Costa-Hawkins does not apply to later co-tenants; optional determination petition available.
Bad-faith fraud/intimidation/coercion and discrimination provisions; civil damages/fees read. A lawful cap-compliant increase is not immunity from motive-based claims.
Non-public competitor-data revenue-management software prohibited; each month/unit separate violation; aggregated public-data reports excluded.
180-day protection tied to specified habitability events and broader retaliation prohibition in (d); lawful-cause savings clause and tenant evidentiary burden read.
Protected characteristics, reasonable accommodation, source-of-income and retaliation guidance read. No uniform-increase safe harbor stated.
Federal protected classes and housing discrimination prohibition read. Page establishes no general numerical rent ceiling; absence finding is scoped to reviewed private unsubsidized housing sources.
Tenant Petition 516C/Form C, no filing charge or stated filing time limit, evidence list, hearing procedure and counselor number read.
Form 1007 is an eviction-termination notice resource; free Tenant Right to Counsel intake through Eviction Defense Collaborative. Does not establish free counsel for every rent-increase dispute.

register_review.verified_rules: R01-R13, R15-R21, R23-R27, R30-R40, R42-R44, R47-R51, R54-R62 matched the retrieved official text/guidance within their stated scope.
register_review.blank_or_absence: R14, R22, R46 and R52 remain blank/no-authority findings; a review link is not verification of a missing property fact or a universal negative.
register_review.analysis: R28-R29, R41, R45 and R53 are reasoning, not quoted rules. Banking reconciliation and unit entitlement depend on unverified complete rent history.
register_review.owner_inputs: Unit dates, rents, 1940 construction, ZIP and occupancy changes are owner-supplied intake, not government-verified records.
register_review.not_certified: No parcel coverage determination, license lookup, lawful-rent determination, notice service, lawyer review or empirical neighborhood/owner-type norm is certified.
